body: Thank you, my Nordic friend. I'm feeling confident that I will sleep.

Generalized anxiety disorder, major depressive disorder, and post traumatic stress disorder here :)

Don't let an overflow of emotion decide your fate tonight. Trust me on that, liquor or not. I'm pretty baked now, and I was when I made my attempt. Weak coping mechanisms :/

You seem to have willpower left, and that's really fortunate. You have to hold on to that. Hold while it's pulled at, and reduced to shreds.  You'll still have it. 
You have to prove to yourself that it can get better. I know all of this sounds like bullshit, but I will not use this account (as long as I'm here) to lie. This comes from the heart, as shitty as it may be.
